tei:div.tei:p: 119) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: gu ru'i gsang sgrub rdo rje'i rgya can shin tu zab pa mkha' 'gro'i thugs bcud zab pa'i mthar thug bzhugs:

gter gyi srung mas bya ra gyis: 120) na mo pad+ma kā ra ye: o rgyan rdo rje 'chang la 'dud: chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod kyi: cha lag rig 'dzin gsang sgrub 'di: mtsho rgyal thugs dam snying po'i chos: khyad 'phags zab chos bla na med: yang zab man ngag shin tu zab: dgongs pa'i klong du brda ru btab: ma 'ongs dus su gtad rgya phrol: skal ldan sems kyi bu dang 'phrad: gcig brgyud gyis la rim bzhin spel: skal ldan kun gyis nyams su longs: sa ma ya: de yang spros med rnal 'byor pas: gdams pa zab mo 'di la brtson: dang po skyabs sems ni: na mo: bde gshegs snying po ye sangs rgyas: rang ngo so mar skyabs su mchi: ma rig sbubs su 'phyan pa'i 'gro: rang grol chen por sems bskyed do: dngos 121) gzhi lha yi ting 'dzin ni: āḥ smra bsam brjod 'das stong pa nyid: 'gag med snying rje'i rang rtsal shar: hrīḥyig yongs su gyur pa las: rang nyid pad+ma thod phreng ni: mthing gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: phyag g.yas rdo rje nam mkhar 'phyar: g.yon pas bhan thod tshe bum 'dzin: dar dang rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol: dbu skra thor cog spyi bor bcings: zhabs gnyis skyil krung pad zlar bzhugs: mdun du ye shes mtsho rgyal ma: dmar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: phyag g.yas cang te'u snyan thad dkrol: g.yon pas dril bud ku la 122)brten: nu ma 'bur zhing bha ga rgyas: gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan dang ni: ut+pal dmar po'i do shal mdzes: zhabs gnyis bzhengs stabs pad zlar bzhugs: 'ja' 'od zer 'khrigs klong na gsal: de yi phyi rim 'dab brgyad la: dpal chen grub pa'i rig 'dzin brgyad: rnal 'byor he ru ka pa'i tshul: zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pa yis: rdo rje g.yon pas bhan thod bsnams: spyan gnyis 'bru tshugs dbyings su gzigs: dar dang rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol: dbu skra thor cog spyi bor bcings: sku mdog dmar smug mdangs dang ldan:

zhabs gnyis rol stabs pad zlar bzhugs: 'ja' 'od 'khyil klong gzi brjid 'bar: snang la rang bzhin med par bskyed: gsal la der 'dzin bral bar bsgom: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum las: 'od 'phros sku gsum zhing khams nas: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i lha tshogs rnams: spyan drangs dam ye dbyer med par: chu la chu thim gnyis med par: ro gcig ngang du brtan par bzhugs: don dam lha la ye phyag 'tshal: mtha' brgyad bral ba'i mchod pa 123)'bul: rig dbyings 'gyur med ngang nas bstod: gnyis snang sgrib pa dbyings su bshags: badz+ra sa ma ya shud+dhe ā: rang nyid rigs 'dus thugs ka ru: hrīḥyig mtha' dmar sngags g.yas 'khor: 'od zer yar 'phros rgyal kun mchod: thugs rje byin rlabs ma lus bsdus: 'od zer mar 'phros 'gro ba yi: las sgrib kun dag bde la bkod: thams cad dag pa rab 'byams ngangaḥ rang bab ma bcos so ma che: der 'dzin bral ba gnyug ma'i klong: ma yengs mi bsgom gzer gyis ni: dkyil 'khor gsum ldan ngang du bzla: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ hrīḥm ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrī ya tsit+ta hring hring dza dzaḥ zhes dang: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra dha ra sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ zha ེsa pa brgya stong khri 'bum sogs: yid bzlas bya zhing dbyings rig bsre: don gyi lha zhal mjal nas kyang: mkha' spyod bgrod par the tshom med: gcig brgyud ma gtogs spel mi rung: spel na ḍā ki'i bka' chad 'bebs: skal ldan kun gyi spyod yul yin: sa ma ya: e sa: mkha' 'gro'i thugs bcud mtsho rgyal 124) thugs dam mthil: zab pa'i mthar thug o rgyan gsang sgrub 'di: chos nyid dgongs pa'i klong du gter du sbos: bka' srung dregs pa rnam gsum gnyer gyis shig: skal ldan sems kyi bu dang 'phrad nas kyang: don gnyis dpal gyis nor bu 'dzin par nges: the tshom med do phyi rabs las can kun:

yal bar ma dor tsit+ta'i gwa'ur chongs: tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob par gdon mi za: sa ma ya: sku rgya: gsung rgya: thugs rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: ḍāk+ki rgya: : zhes pa rig 'dzin gsang sgrub zab mo 'di rtogs grol rnal 'byor dam pa 'od chos kyis yang yang bskul ngor mi ldog tsam du sprang mo mdo med su kha badz+ra gyis snyan brgyud la brten nas dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni kun bzang snang mdzad kyis bris pa'o// dge'o//
